part.text:
Migration complete. The `pages` directory has been removed and all routes/files moved to the App Router under `app`.

Key changes:
- `app/layout.tsx` replaces `_app.js` and `_document.js`, using `next/font/google` and `Metadata`.
- `app/page.tsx` is an async Server Component using `headers()` instead of `getServerSideProps`.
- `app/blog/page.tsx` and `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` use `revalidate`, `generateStaticParams`, and `generateMetadata`.
- `app/not-found.tsx` and `app/error.tsx` replace `404.js` and `_error.js`.
- API routes are now `app/api/posts/route.ts` and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` with `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`.
- Components converted to TypeScript and shared types added in `types.ts`.

`npm run build` passes successfully.
